meta.description: Tests distinctions between LAN and WAN.

question.text: Which TWO statements correctly describe common network types? Select two.
options: A LAN typically connects devices within a limited geographic area
A WAN can connect networks across large geographic distances
A WAN must use only wireless links
A LAN always spans multiple countries
correctAnswers: A LAN typically connects devices within a limited geographic area
A WAN can connect networks across large geographic distances
